neighbours.label: hedge or example-introducing words after a quantity or list ('details such as', 'just over $1 million')
fire: It must come with basic details such as location and opening hours.
The renovations come to just over $1 million.
Bring a few essentials such as water and a hat.
The new bridge cost just under two billion dollars.
Include key facts such as the date and the venue.
The crowd numbered just over ten thousand people.
Add common spices such as cumin and paprika.
The trip took just under four hours.
